faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about biubiu.tools. Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out to our community.

items.question: What is biubiu.tools?
items.answer: biubiu.tools is Ethereum-first power tools for Web3 power users. Whether you're a data analyst querying on-chain data, a developer deploying contracts across chains, or an airdrop hunter managing multiple wallets - we provide batch operation tools that save 80%+ time and gas.

items.question: Is this tool secure?
items.answer: Your private keys never leave your browser - all operations are performed locally. We don't store any sensitive data. The code is 100% open source on GitHub for you to audit, and you can self-host your own instance anytime.

items.question: Which blockchain networks are supported?
items.answer: We support Ethereum and 20+ EVM-compatible chains including BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Avalanche, and more. Permissionlessly supports any EVM-compatible chain - no waiting for official integration. You can also add custom RPC networks.

items.question: Can I test the app on a testnet?
items.answer: Yes! Any testnet works - Sepolia, local Anvil, or your own dev network. Just connect a testnet wallet and start testing. No permission needed.

items.question: Can I deploy it myself?
items.answer: Absolutely! The code is fully open source and you can deploy it to any EVM chain. Self-hosted versions have zero protocol fees, perfect for developers and technical teams. See the deployment docs in our GitHub repository.

items.question: How can I get help if I have issues?
items.answer: Join our Telegram community for real-time support. For technical issues or feature requests, submit an Issue on GitHub. We typically respond within 24 hours.
